action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves to identify the best continuation while up an exchange and rook.
action.rationale: Broad search required. Need evidence across all roots before selecting a candidate. Position is materially winning (two rooks vs rook, but Black has two rooks actually: Rooks d7/h1 vs e6/e3). Actually material is roughly equal; need accurate evaluation. Cover all roots at depth 4 within 3000 nodes.
